text:
sara_ml: Heads-up — on the miraql-v1 q3a bring-up I'm seeing a consistent translation quality regression for zh->en and ar->en compared to the fp16 baseline. Quick summary: BLEU 27.8 -> 24.3 on zh->en validation set, chrF 0.54 -> 0.48, and embedding similarity mean dropped 0.92 -> 0.87. Not catastrophic but noticeable in production signals and some locale-specific failure modes.

james_rte: ouch. which eval slice looks worst? noisy shortctx? numbers by bucket?

sara_ml: worst on CJK numeric+bracket contexts and RTL bracket mirroring cases. I sliced by tokens per sentence and by presence of ZWJ/ZWSP/halfwidth punctuation. Short (<40 tok) with mixed fullwidth digits or ZWJ have the largest delta. I can paste small repro.

maria_i18n: pinging me. can you paste examples? if it's tokenization-related we might need tokenizer tweak or detok path.

sara_ml: example 1 (zh->en)
```
SRC: 会議定于2025年10月10日（周五）10:00在会议室A-2召开。
REF: The meeting is scheduled for Friday, October 10, 2025 at 10:00 in Conference Room A-2.
BASE_FP16: The meeting is scheduled for Friday, October 10, 2025 at 10:00 in Meeting Room A-2.
MIRAQL_Q3A: Meeting set for 2025-10-10 10:00 in Conference Room A - 2.
```
notes: q3a output inserts extra spaces around the hyphen and sometimes splits the "A-2" token into "A - 2" which our downstream routing treats as different product id.

james_rte: that split could be detok or tokenization change. are token IDs different between runs? can you diff token sequences?

sara_ml: token diffs below (showing grapheme-ish tokens, simplified):
```
FP16 tokens: ["会","議","定","于","2025","年","10","月","10","日","（","周","五","）","10",":","00","在","会议室A-2","召","开","。"]
Q3A tokens: ["会","議","定","于","2025","年","10","月","10","日","（","周","五","）","10",":","00","在","会议室A-2","A","-","2","召","开","。"]
```
so the quant variant is splitting the alphanumeric run. This correlates with the scoring drop on numeric/bracket buckets.

maria_i18n: hmm maybe the tokenizer fallback uses a different regex under quant contortions? We ship the same tokenizer binary, so likely tokenization is ok at encode time. Could be detokenizer (postprocess) uses different join heuristics triggered by subtoken boundary markers lost in quant path.

kevin_infra: deploy-bot says the canary rollout is still at 10% (miraql-v1-q3a). I can pause rollout if we decide. deploy-bot: Can I help pause the canary? :deploy:

deploy-bot: @kevin_infra you can run `/canary pause miraql-v1-q3a` — doing that requires approvals.

james_rte: before pausing, can we run an A/B on detok variants: (1) use legacy detok codepath, (2) full new detok with punctuation-normalization, (3) artificially disable KVCACHE prefix normalization to see if token boundaries change. If (1) fixes it then it's detok. If none fix, might be kernel-level rounding of logits altering BPE merges.

sara_ml: ran a small smoke: forcing legacy detok in the q3a path recovers A-2 intact in 17/20 samples. So looks detok-adjacent. But we also saw small re-ranking differences where numeral formatting flips ("10:00" -> "10 : 00") in some RTL Arabic cases. Example ar->en: SRC with rtl brackets and arabic-Indic digits sometimes ends up with bracket orientation flip in q3a.

maria_i18n: can you paste the ar example?

sara_ml: ar example (abbreviated)
```
SRC: الموعد يوم ١٠/١٠/٢٠٢٥ (الجمعة) الساعة ١٠:٠٠ — قاعة A32
REF: The appointment is on 10/10/2025 (Friday) at 10:00 — Hall A-2.
FP16: The appointment is on 10/10/2025 (Friday) at 10:00 — Hall A-2.
MIRAQL_Q3A: The appointment is on 10/10/2025 )Friday( at 10 : 00 — Hall A - 2.
```
observations: closing bracket mirrored and spacing around colon/hyphen altered. Some of these are bidi/detok combos.

kevin_infra: could be byte-level differences: q3 kernels use different mem alignment and we saw earlier a stray zeroing bug that affected trailing joiners. But that was fixed. I'll run a kernel smoke diff job across encoding/decoding pipelines.

james_rte: Also run the same sentences through the tokenizer binary used in hosting vs our offline eval harness — confirm identical tokenized sequence bytes. I've seen hosting use an older tokenizer wheel accidentally.

sara_ml: good call. I validated offline tokenizer bytes: identical. Hosting tokenizer on canary showed the split as well, so it's post-tokenize. I dumped the internal surrogate markers: q3a detok seems to drop a zero-width-joiner marker in some sequences (ZWJ present in src).

maria_i18n: dropping ZWJ would cause grapheme splits and spacing changes. Any quick patch? maybe reintroduce conservative detok join rules for alnum runs and ZWJ contexts.

sara_ml: I made a quick patch in my local eval that forces rejoin on pattern: ([A-Za-z0-9]|FullwidthDigit)+ (ZWJ?)-?([A-Za-z0-9]|FullwidthDigit)+ and the sample outputs align with fp16. Local eval improved BLEU delta by ~0.8 points on the numeric+ZWJ slice.

kevin_infra: we should still run a controlled canary with the detok fallback. Suggest: pause rollout, release a patched detok q3a canary, compare automated metrics (BLEU, chrF, embedding sim) and product key metrics (id routing misclassification rate).

james_rte: +1. Also run a quantization ablation where we produce logits with higher-precision final layer (mixed-precision final linear) to test if rounding in final softmax is contributing. If detok patch fully recovers, skip the ablation for now.

maria_i18n: happy to signoff on detok fallback for short-term. We need to create an i18n testset that includes these ZWJ/numeric/bracket combos so this doesn't regress again. I can seed a set of 2k examples from support logs and our synthetic generator.

sara_ml: I'll open a PR with the detok fallback + unit tests and attach a small sample dataset. Also adding evaluation slices to the onboarding checklist: numeric/bracket, ZWJ presence, RTL bracket mirroring.

kevin_infra: pausing rollout now (approve?). deploy-bot: pausing canary miraql-v1-q3a at 10%...

deploy-bot: Canary paused. previous traffic restored to fp16 baseline.

james_rte: thanks team. next steps: (1) PR detok fallback, (2) run mixed-precision final-layer ablation overnight, (3) add i18n regression suite to onboarding CI. Assign owners?

sara_ml: I'll own PR and regression suite.

maria_i18n: I'll collect the 2k examples and add linting rules for detok.

kevin_infra: I'll run the ablation job and kernel mem-alignment regressions.

sara_ml: filing a short incident ticket and linking to this thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
